newsitem.title: FRANCE: Press watchdog says Algerian journalist abducted.
newsitem.headline: Press watchdog says Algerian journalist abducted.

text.p: The press watchdog Reporters without Borders (RsF) said on Wednesday an Algerian journalist was missing after being abducted from his home by men dressed as policemen.
The Paris-based RsF said Aziz Bouabdallah of the daily al-Alam al-Siyassi was kidnapped last Friday night and his relatives had not been able to confirm that the abductors were genuine policemen.
RsF urged President Liamine Zeroual to open an inquiry into his whereabouts.

It said 57 journalists had been killed in Algeria over the past few years and three were missing. Journalists have been targets for Moslem fundamentalist rebels in the bloody civil strife that followed the cancellation of 1992 elections Islamists were poised to win.
